exposure: genetic defects (paternal uniparental heterodisomy (hUPD) at the GNAS locus)
mixed isodisomy and heterodisomy of chromosome 20
cohort: The study included a single patient clinically diagnosed with iPPSD3.
finding: Paternal uniparental heterodisomy (hUPD) at the GNAS locus was identified as a genetic defect associated with iPPSD3 in the patient.
